title: Helping Central Kentucky families remember the people they love
intro: Choosing a memorial is one of the last things you do for someone. We make the process simple and unhurried, from the first question to the day the stone is set.
story:
Central KY Monuments, LLC is honored to serve families throughout Central Kentucky during some of life's most difficult chapters — and to help them thoughtfully prepare for the future. Whether you are honoring a loved one today or planning ahead for tomorrow, we provide compassionate guidance and create meaningful, lasting memorials that reflect each unique life and legacy.

From traditional monuments and markers to fully customized designs, we are committed to bringing your vision to life with care, craftsmanship, and attention to every detail. No request is too big or too small — if it matters to you, it matters to us.

steps.title: Choose a design
steps.text: Browse the gallery for ideas or tell us what you have in mind. Every design can be adapted.

steps.title: Personalize and approve
steps.text: Pick the granite color, size and lettering. You'll approve a design proof before anything is made.

steps.title: Installation
steps.text: We coordinate with the cemetery and install your memorial, foundation included, so you don't have to manage the details.

serviceIntro: We serve families throughout Central Kentucky, including these communities and the surrounding counties. If your cemetery is farther away, just ask.
ctaText: Call us or send a note, and we'll help you take the next step.
